description: Synthetic RevOps dataset for deterministic tests; no real customer or person data

forecast_categories.pipeline: Early/renewal deals not yet committed by the owner
forecast_categories.best_case: Plausible upside; not included in commit

approved_context.title: Open pipeline definition
approved_context.definition: Open pipeline contains deals whose mapped stage is open. Closed-won and closed-lost are excluded unless explicitly requested.

approved_context.title: Forecast bases
approved_context.definition: Category, weighted pipeline, and submitted manager forecasts are distinct bases. Amount × Probability is weighted pipeline, not a submitted forecast.

approved_context.title: Fiscal calendar
approved_context.definition: The fiscal year starts in February in Europe/Madrid. For example, August-October 2026 is FY2027-Q3 and November 2026-January 2027 is FY2027-Q4.

approved_context.title: Reporting currency and missing amounts
approved_context.definition: The only supported reporting currency is EUR. A non-null amount in another currency is rejected until an FX policy is approved. Null amounts remain null and are never treated as zero.
